_comment: Official ELEGOO OTA 02.01.01.13, captured on 2026-11-08 from the user's own printer (online update, hard-linked by tools/capture/ota_keeper.sh). Outer, inner and manifest ELEG signatures verify with keys/cc2_stock_public.pem and both embedded payload SHA-256 values match. Pins were measured with tools/inspect_base.py and unsquashfs 4.7.5. The build stays refused until a patch set is ported to this base.
_comment_stock_package: the device stored it as /opt/usr/firmware/elegoo_firmware; this is the file name embedded in its outer ELEG header plus .sig
_comment_manifest: Read from the decrypted official ota-package-list.json with tools/inspect_base.py and the AES input found as /opt/inst/daemon-000/aes_key.key in this base (same SHA-256 as AES key v1). The manifest also lists the inner .swu.sig with SHA-256 06fd9fc7...35f8, matching stock_inner.
_comment_ported_patch_set: true only after Z-offset (GUI), HTTP/network (elegoo_printer) and camera (ai_camera) patches are ported to this base, emulation-tested and hardware-tested. daemon-000 and libcolib.so are byte-identical to 02.01.01.07.

outputs._comment_camera_init: The printer init as camera.install validates it (after reactor.install, before the camera patch = stock+reactor). Device-verified base-independent: reversing the camera patch from the 02.01.01.13 device /etc/init.d/printer (final e7537298...) yields exactly this value, identical to 02.01.01.07. Not the final installed init (e7537298, which connections NATIVE pins).

native_display.reason: Not ported to 02.01.01.13. The hardware-validated device runs the plain Z-offset GUI (port.outputs.patched_gui 668ab8cb...), never the native-display reskin, so the builder keeps that GUI, skips display.install and asserts the native display is absent (PIPELINE_MULTI_BASE_DESIGN.md section 3.5). Native display is a separate, independently hardware-tested port; see experimental/firmware-port-0113/NATIVE_DISPLAY_0113_ANALYSIS.md.

connections_usb_ethernet.reason: Not ported to 02.01.01.13. The cc2_ue300_*.ko USB-Ethernet modules are built against the vendor kernel ABI; the 0113 kernel (TinaLinux 5.4.61 build #40, bf965943...) differs from the public 07-era tree (OpenCentauri/oc-linux cd4ee0cf) and abi_probe reports a struct usb_device layout mismatch, so the 07 modules cannot load. Native Wi-Fi Connections (stock aic8800_fdrv.ko, verified) ships normally; the builder skips the USB-Ethernet modules and asserts their absence (PIPELINE_MULTI_BASE_DESIGN.md section 3.5). A separate, later addition once the matching 0113 kernel source is available; see experimental/firmware-port-0113/REACTOR_CONNECTIONS_0113_STATUS.md.
